discovery_notes: Search-snippet leads only (34 searches). dsuk = sold on Disney Store UK/EU (often also US); dsus = shopDisney/US-only evidence. Disney100 Decades keyed dsuk because EU listings exist, though many decade pins only have US-blog evidence. No 2020-2023 Disney Store London event pins or Pin Trading Day store pins found. Undated UK items skipped: Up 10th anniv set, DS UK bauble advent calendar (GBP175), Treasure Planet/Scar (2017-era). New Year 2020 pin released Dec 2019. Several GBP/EUR prices may be markdowns.
